pages.name: River Bee
pages.text: Lesser Bubba Star. Overworld, by day (also works in rain).

Each trip it brings home a river comb (clay) or a gravel comb (gravel and flint), half and half.$(br2)$(l)Flowers:$() Clay, Gravel$(br2)$(l)Home biome:$() River$(br2)$(l)Brings home$() (busy hive):$(li)River Honeycomb: half the trips, 105 per hive-hour$(li)Gravel Honeycomb: half the trips, 105 per hive-hour
$(l)Water-safe:$() Works in the rain and takes no damage from water.
Use it on a vanilla bee.
